scope: Post-CPU bounded connection regression. Existing manual12 cases reused; supplemental synthetic dense traces below are not independent human/fresh semantic evidence. No native window, keyboard, IME, OS capture or resources measured.
pipeline: Actual Swift AmbientReceiverBridge -> frozen R3 only allocator/readBody -> actual AmbientProjection -> actual AmbientRenderer.rebuild/ambientInstances and atlas -> unmodified Geometry R3 MSL render/validateSurface kernels. No Matter.add, no extra glyph IDs or fake @ material. An unattached paused MTKView supplies dimensions only; no GUI event loop/drawable used.
cases: 4 existing manual states A01/A03/A09/A12 plus 3 lexical shapes x white/mixed supplemental connection fixtures. In supplemental fixtures old224 units white, new32 units white or blue. All events are declared artificial commits.
geometry: sphere->sphere, box->cube, ring->Mobius display-only. Count256 cap. Time24, birth=first CPU read observation0, seed1, settled pose, frontal angles0. This excludes intake/morph/pause/hidden/UI resources.
finiteScope: CPU instance/uniform numeric payloads and unmodified validateSurface p/u/v base frames for actual receiver IDs. Does not inspect every raster/fragment intermediate, and not general geometry revalidation.
pixelScope: BGRA8 readback maxRGB>8 lit; blue b>1.5g && b>2r && b>8. Pixel presence not readability, comfort, semantic accuracy or WebGL pixel equivalence. Bounds are diagnostic, only inside texture gate.
preservation: Source/fixtures freeze before build/run. Refuse overwrite outputs. Failure stays R1; changes require new R2. Runtime payloads are artificial only. Normal app remains raw-saving-off.
